## **Exercise 5** Describe a qq-plot in terms of the grammar of graphics and the data you need to make one. (You migth start by reminding yourself – or asking someone – what a qq-plot is.)

Create a qq-plot (you may choose the data; perhaps use one of the features of penguins) using the [quantile transform](https://vega.github.io/vega-lite/docs/quantile.html).

qq-plot contains points, line, and area

```{r}
library(vegabrite)
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
vega_data <- altair::import_vega_data()
penguins
```

```{r}
vl_chart(width = 150, height = 60) |>
  vl_mark_point()|>
  vl_encode_x()|>
  vl_add_data(penguins)
```
